A '''planet''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Blix Annon]]. Annon represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. While en route to his homeworld, Annon [[Death/Legends|died]] of a heart attack during a kidnapping attempt.
